Subject:            •   Voting result
                    •   REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE
                        COUNCIL on the establishment of ‘Eurodac’ for the comparison of
                        biometric data in order to effectively apply Regulations (EU) …/… and

                        Directive 2001/55/EC and to identify illegally staying third-country
                        nationals and stateless persons and on requests for the comparison

                        Europol for law enforcement purposes, amending Regulations (EU)
